description.narrative: Despite their official welcome Venezuelan migrants in Ecuador often face daunting challenges when it comes to finding a decent job or fitting into their communities. At the IAF we support community-led approaches to expanding economic opportunity and promoting social inclusion. Grantee partner Fundacin de las Amricas (FUDELA) is working with Venezuelan migrants and local Ecuadorians to provide training in small business development job skills and leadership. These activities will increase incomes for migrants and members of the communities receiving them alike. The grantee will also strengthen community and build leadership networks among local and migrant youth promoting social acceptance and a more inclusive society.This grant is part of the IAF?s commitment to support displaced Venezuelans and communities impacted by the Venezuelan humanitarian crisis. Amendment FY21 :This amendment provides an additional one year and $143,300 to FuDe to mitigate the economic and psychosocial effects of the COVID-19 pandemic affecting marginalized and at-risk youth and their communities in eleven Latin American countries. FuDe is improving access throughout the region to reliable information, resources and tools that engage youth on issues related to COVID-19 and its economic and social effects. It is also piloting a seed capital fund that supports youth-led solutions to community problems. Finally, FuDe is developing a strategy to strengthen internal and external communication about its conflict mediation training platform and to attract partners and sponsors to the street soccer movement. This grant is part of the IAF's expanded strategy in response to COVID-19.
